name: sb_get_active_buffer_offset
desc: Get base offset of the currently active audio buffer
details: Inspects the active double-buffer ID stored at CS:[001Ch]. If buffer 1 is active (value is 1), returns 0x001F in DI; otherwise returns 0x061F in DI for buffer 2.

ret.name: buf_offset
ret.desc: Base offset of the active audio buffer within the CS segment (0x001F or 0x061F)

0823:1068.comment: Buffer 2 is active: set DI to offset 0x061F

0823:1060.comment: Check if buffer 1 is the active buffer

0823:106c.comment: Buffer 1 is active: set DI to offset 0x001F
0823:106c.label: buffer_1
